title: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Neil Armstrong?
description:
Five real photos connect Adolf Hitler to Neil Armstrong.

Adolf Hitler → Yōsuke Matsuoka → Joseph Stalin → Mao Zedong → Richard Nixon → Neil Armstrong

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Adolf Hitler → Yōsuke Matsuoka: In March 1941, Hitler hosted Japan's foreign minister, Yosuke Matsuoka, in Berlin.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Matsuoka_and_Hitler_(cropped).jpg
2. Yōsuke Matsuoka → Joseph Stalin: Two weeks later, Matsuoka was in Moscow, signing a neutrality pact while Joseph Stalin looked on.
   Photo by Николай Сидорович Власик, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Matsuoka_signs_the_Soviet%E2%80%93Japanese_Neutrality_Pact-1.jpg
3. Joseph Stalin → Mao Zedong: In 1949, Mao Zedong came to Moscow for Stalin's seventieth birthday.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mao,_Bulganin,_Stalin,_Ulbricht_Tsedenbal.jpeg
4. Mao Zedong → Richard Nixon: In 1972, Richard Nixon became the first American president to visit Mao in China.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Richard_Nixon_and_Mao_Zedong.jpg
5. Richard Nixon → Neil Armstrong: And back in 1969, Nixon greeted Neil Armstrong through a quarantine window, days after he walked on the Moon.
   Photo by NASA, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Nixon_welcomes_the_Apollo_11_astronauts_aboard_the_U.S.S._Hornet.jpg

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
